# SpatiotemporalRecurrentFramework

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A recurrent neural network architecture that processes both spatial and temporal dimensions of spiking data simultaneously, enabling state-space modeling of neural dynamics. Provides a unified framework for capturing complex neural interactions across space and time, essential for realistic neuromorphic computing.
